## Workload

Grader Tomas Brennan recorded 1034 completed reads during 450 hours of grading activity. This represents a recorded rate of 2.3 reads per hour. The workload record provides a basis for considering the volume completed alongside the quality findings below. It also indicates the scale of work undertaken during the review period, without relying on an estimate beyond the stated rate.

## Quality

A further 81 reads were checked as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement result was 49.4. This finding should be considered alongside the workload information and the nature of the material reviewed. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases, identifying these cases for attention in the review record.

The review was completed by Priya Anand, with Tomas Brennan identified as the grader.
